sections.Profile:
"Play Time" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1973. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, a mushroom bumper, two slingshots, six standup targets, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1973
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Boats, Single Player, Racing, Sports, Original Theme, Skiing, 1970s, Motorcycles
